name: STomp
ref: the checkout the bench runs from (its repoRoot); describe() records its HEAD and whether src/ or dist/ differ from it

serve./bench-config.js: generated by the adapter from this file

controller.mode: same-origin StompController in the host page

transport.name: epoxy
transport.summary: epoxy (Fracital build: 256 KiB HTTP/2 header list, 64 KiB wisp packets within CONTINUE credit) in the transport worker, over the shared holyWisp

rowOptions.rewriter: 'wasm' passes rewriter: 'wasm' to the controller; 'js' passes nothing (the default)
rowOptions.adblock: false passes adblock: false; absent leaves the content blocker on (the default)

assets.what: what a row's browser downloads for the proxy machinery (the size scenario): every .js, .mjs, .wasm and .html file in dist/ (not .map, not types/) at /stomp/, plus the transport files at /epoxy/; checked by logging the host server's requests during a boot and a page load per row

exclude.SearchBuilder.js: only the demo's address bar uses it
exclude.Controller.js: the classic-script build of the controller; the host page imports controller.mjs
exclude.controllerFrame.html: only the deployment mode with a separate proxy origin loads it
exclude.controllerFrame.js: only the deployment mode with a separate proxy origin loads it
exclude.rtc.wasm: the WebRTC stand-in stack (src/inject/dom/rtcStack, src/rtc/worker, str0m as rtc.wasm); loaded only when a document first constructs an RTCPeerConnection, which the size and browsing scenarios never do, so it is not in the proxy's download total (its bytes are reported separately in RESULTS.md)
exclude.rtcStack.js: the WebRTC stand-in stack (src/inject/dom/rtcStack, src/rtc/worker, str0m as rtc.wasm); loaded only when a document first constructs an RTCPeerConnection, which the size and browsing scenarios never do, so it is not in the proxy's download total (its bytes are reported separately in RESULTS.md)
exclude.rtcWorker.js: the WebRTC stand-in stack (src/inject/dom/rtcStack, src/rtc/worker, str0m as rtc.wasm); loaded only when a document first constructs an RTCPeerConnection, which the size and browsing scenarios never do, so it is not in the proxy's download total (its bytes are reported separately in RESULTS.md)

onDemand.injectWorker.js: loaded once a proxied page starts a worker (counted: real sites do)
onDemand.h3/stomp_h3.js, h3/stomp_h3_bg.wasm: loaded once an origin offers HTTP/3: with the blocker on, its list downloads do at boot; without it, the first real site that offers HTTP/3 (counted for every row, since transport.http3 is on for all)

transport.note: files of the transport package's dist/ at /epoxy/: always its module; with transport.http3 the stomp-h3 module too, which loads once an origin offers HTTP/3 (the blocker's list downloads do)

notes: same-origin StompController (what the demo runs on 127.0.0.1); the deployment mode with a separate proxy origin adds a controller frame and is not measured
codec xor, HTTP cache on, emulated service workers on (demo defaults)
HTTP/3 on for origins that offer it (demo default; QUIC over wisp UDP)
ECH: epoxy asks Cloudflare DoH for HTTPS records (demo default)
cross-origin isolation headers on the host (COOP same-origin, COEP credentialless), as the demo server sends by default
rewriterLib.js is served immutable (max-age one year) when asked for by its content hash, as the demo server does; every other host file is no-cache
content blocker on by default (rows stomp-js, stomp-wasm); stomp-noadblock turns it off
